propositions: A new read-only, S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite must be added under tests/external/live_jira_cloud_s3/ to exercise REB and DIG projects across the S3 store backend with real Cloud ticket volume.

The suite must enforce structural read-only invariants by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods (create_issue, update_issue, add_comment, add_label, remove_label, set_entity_property, delete_issue, transition_issue_by_name, unassign_issue, set_parent, update_priority, update_issuetype, update_comment, delete_comment, delete_issue_link) to raise JiraWriteForbidden.

Read-only paths compute_snapshot and bridge_preview with Mode.DRY_RUN must fetch multi-project real volume from REB and DIG into an isolated S3-backed store via a throwaway s3://<bucket>/<prefix> remote, with per-project Jira issue counts verified identical before and after.
Unknown mapped project keys must fail closed (raise) during compute_snapshot rather than silently succeeding, and unknown projects must be excluded from the mapping to prevent prior test failures.

The test suite must be integrated into CI as a dedicated manually-dispatched jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal job in .github/workflows/external-integration.yml, and the existing external job must ignore the new test directory to prevent double-collection.
Throwaway S3 prefixes must be deleted in test teardown, and all code must pass ruff check, ruff format --check, and mypy validation.
